## About
Better Plumbing is Cameron's shop on Berryessa St in Milpitas. He serves neighbors here and across Santa Clara and Alameda Counties, for homes, commercial properties and light industrial buildings.
Cameron's view is simple: fixing a problem before you understand why it happened just delays it happening again. So he takes the time to troubleshoot, uses quality parts and does careful work. As he puts it, "The bitterness of poor quality lingers long after the cheap price is forgotten."
Customers rate Better Plumbing 4.9 from 34 Google reviews. One longtime customer called him "very honest, very trustworthy."

## Services
- Plumbing evaluation: A no obligation inspection to see if your system could use modernizing to reduce costs, be greener, add safety, or just needs minor adjustments.
- Fixing leaks: A leak can show up first as a high water bill. Cameron tracks down where the water is going and fixes it.
- Water and sewer replacement under the house: Full replacement of the water and sewer plumbing under a house, out to every fixture inside.
- Shower valve problems: One reviewer had a stuck valve cartridge another plumber couldn't get out. Cameron got it out and fixed it the least expensive way.
- Residential, commercial and light industrial plumbing: Each kind of system has its own demands, from restaurants and office buildings to strip malls. Cameron works on all of them.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Milpitas, plus residents of Santa Clara and Alameda Counties.

Q: Do you work on commercial properties?
A: Yes. Better Plumbing has over 30 years of commercial experience in all types of plumbing systems.

Q: Will you look for the least expensive fix?
A: That's the goal. One reviewer was facing a full valve housing replacement, and Cameron fixed it the cheaper way instead.
